name: Handover - direct human request
description: Customer explicitly asks to speak to a real person. AI should immediately handover without resistance.

messages.text: Hi, I need some information about your products
Can I speak to a real person please

expected_behaviors.description: AI should mention a human team member

forbidden_patterns.pattern: I can help you with that|let me assist|I'm able to help
forbidden_patterns.description: AI should not resist the handover request

notes: AI must not try to convince the customer to keep talking to the bot. Immediate handover.
